subject.title: [Bug]: Agent / sessions_spawn tool_use can emit with no matching tool_result and no parent-visible signal — silent subagent drop (~3.8% historical rate)

question: Which parent-visible terminal contract should OpenClaw guarantee when subagent completion delivery fails: durable queued tool_result/error completion, a narrower blocked-task wake, or diagnostics-only handling?
rationale: Source inspection proves remaining silent paths, but the permanent fix crosses transcript pairing, durable delivery, session wake semantics, and provider strictness, so automation should not choose the model-facing contract unilaterally.

options.title: Durable Tool Result Completion Contract
options.body: Persist or queue a terminal subagent completion that wakes the requester and writes a matching synthetic error tool_result for every outstanding subagent tool call.

options.title: Narrow Give-Up Wake First
options.body: Land a bounded parent-wake fix for retry-limit or expiry give-up while tracking tool_result pairing and durable replay as follow-up work.

options.title: Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct announce semantics and add stronger operator diagnostics without changing parent transcript behavior, accepting that strict-provider sessions may still stall or reject.

recommendation.title: Durable Tool Result Completion Contract
recommendation.body: Persist or queue a terminal subagent completion that wakes the requester and writes a matching synthetic error tool_result for every outstanding subagent tool call.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across subagent announce delivery, registry lifecycle, and related helper refactors.
